episodes.name: Pat the Horse
episodes.overview: Patrick wants to be a horse.

episodes.overview: Gary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm. Everyone loves it, except for Squidward.

episodes.name: Moving Bubble Bass

episodes.name: Bunny Hunt
episodes.overview: A sea bunny ravages Squidward's garden, but SpongeBob thinks it's cute.

episodes.name: High Sea Diving
episodes.overview: SpongeBob wants to be the first sponge that dives to the surface of the ocean.

episodes.name: Bottle Burglars
episodes.overview: SpongeBob and Squidward accidentally let Plankton slip away with the formula, and it is up to them to retrieve it.

episodes.name: My Leg!
episodes.overview: Once Fred's leg heals up, SpongeBob is determined to keep it out of harm's way.

episodes.name: Ink Lemonade

episodes.name: Mustard O' Mine
episodes.overview: When the Krusty Krab runs out of mustard, Mr. Krabs sends SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward to dig up some more.

episodes.overview: After spilling a milkshake during a delivery, SpongeBob vows to return and clean the entire building.

episodes.name: Library Cards

episodes.name: Plankton Paranoia

episodes.overview: When a gang of kids steal the Krusty Krab's grill, SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs go to extreme lengths to win it back.

episodes.overview: SpongeBob helps out the Krusty Krab's night shift crew, but the customers crave something creepier than usual.

episodes.name: Bubble Town

episodes.name: Squirrel Jelly
episodes.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick have their peaceful day of jellyfishing disturbed by Sandy's competitive nature.

episodes.name: The String
episodes.overview: SpongeBob pulls from Squidward's shirt a loose string that never seems to end.

episodes.name: Goons on the Moon
episodes.overview: Sandy takes her Science Scout troop on a trip to the moon. In space, no one can hear you NYAH-NYAH-NYAH-NYAH.

name: Season 11
overview: Season 11 is surfacing, and it's bringing some of the most unforgettable characters in Bikini Bottom with it! Dive headfirst into 50 deep-sea tales of nautical nonsense! Enter DoodleBob's alternate dimension and take a trip to Bubble Buddy's hometown. Help SpongeBob keep Fred's leg out of harm's way, move Bubble Bass out of his mom's basement, and stop SpongeGar from wreaking havoc all over town! Make new friends, including an imaginary hamster, a sea bunny, the Krusty Krab's peculiar night crew and Sandy's nutty nieces. Plus, take a trip to the moon, solve the curious case of the missing clarinet and hear Gary speak for the very first time ever!
